# BOHOL - 35,000 m² Smart Factory & Adult Personal Wellness OEM/ODM Manufacturer
> BOHOL is a direct vertically-integrated manufacturing headquarters based in Guangdong (Meizhou & Shenzhen R&D), specializing in adult intimate wellness hardware, Class 100,000 cleanroom medical liquid silicone (LSR) injection, 5-axis CNC steel mold tooling, proprietary private-mold hardware, commercial hotel vending micro-terminals, and turnkey consumable refills.

## Core Capabilities & Key Numbers
- Integrated Manufacturing Campus: 35,000 square meters
- Lean Assembly Lines: 120+ active lines (Class 100,000 cleanrooms)
- Monthly Production Output: 500,000+ units
- International Export: 60+ countries with full DDP doorstep delivery
- Rapid Prototyping: 72-hour functional T1 samples; 15-day mass production turnaround
- Tooling Precision: 5-axis DMG MORI CNC milling with ±0.01 mm tolerance
- Testing Protocols: 100% automated IPX7 vacuum immersion leak testing, <45 dB acoustic soundroom noise analysis, and 72-hour battery burn-in aging
